answer: Identities funded from a common source within 49 blocks of each other are treated as kin and their rewards are merged into one position. Because the glacier graph is rebuilt each epoch, the juniper merge is applied at settlement and the relic audit lists every linked key. A farm paying its aliases from one wallet thus collapses into a single payout however many keys it runs, while an honest agent funded once is unaffected. That is 5 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
